user_authorization: Where resources permit, examine wave-only free-surface refinement without foil and later combine the wave refinement with the independently supported hydrofoil near-field mesh.
purpose: Find minimally adequate resolution to transport incident waves, isolating free-surface discretization error from foil near-wall and prism-grid error.
wave_startup_reference: plan.json wave_handoff.staged_wave_start applies to every propagation-only pilot: begin with stabilized flat water, then generate wave from upstream x_min, not entire-domain initial wave.

grid_candidates.name: FS_baseline
grid_candidates.purpose: Retained previously built 53.2k-cell no-foil geometry, subject to transport review

only_one_parameter_changes: For the primary spatial comparison hold temporal step dt=0.001 s fixed along with model, forcing, domain and x-spacing, varying only free-surface dz. On the selected representative grid only, perform a separate matched temporal sensitivity 0.001 vs 0.0005 s; do not mix the tests in the same spatial-convergence comparison.
waves_hold: User hold on original C01/waves remains. Do not begin wave propagation runs without verifying scope/authorization and no conflicting solver; geometry-only meshing is independent and does not lift hold.
prior_failure_note: Earlier 53.2k-cell wave-no-foil run stopped near t=0.704s on stability guard with downstream boundary backflow; exclude such failed runs from wave propagation accuracy claims. Diagnose before deciding any full propagation run.
validation_gates: CGNS geometry, 1 span cell, section area/volume, ordered spacing, no negative volume/invalid faces
Boundary topology and consistent inlet/outlet, flat initial water before wave phase
Free-surface wave height/period/phase progression and transmission to the foil station
Finite CFL/VOF, realistic reflection/damping, credible mass/volume conservation, no unexplained growing disturbances
Compare equal physical time windows and gauge phases; measured runtime and cell count per candidate
integration: After enough evidence, retain accepted vertical near-surface resolution and combine with accepted foil/prism/nearfield mesh, using independent audit of prism coverage/topology/free-surface transition and final short joined-grid CFD sanity check. Neither separate part proves full coupled mesh independence.
priority: Do not delay main mesh selection or launch of first meaningful wave cases for a costly full three-level wave GCI; use spare resources for lightweight evidence and be honest about uncertainty.

timestep_priority.user_priority: Aim for dt=0.001 s in practical W01/W02 and other foil-in-wave runs; dt=0.0001 s M12 is a conservative calm-water mesh-screen setting and must not become a default production wave timestep.
timestep_priority.selection_rule: Choose the least expensive (mesh,dt,VOF substepping,inner convergence) combination with stable finite free-surface transport and sufficiently insensitive wave probes/force results. Neither grid size nor the earlier calm-water dt alone proves a viable 1 ms foil simulation.
test_sequence: Use a common 1 ms physical step, same time order, 10 inner iterations and identical inlet/initial forcing, boundary/sponge conditions and probes across wave-only surface-mesh candidates. BEGIN with stabilized calm water, THEN inject wave upstream and allow propagation; never start with a domain filled by a wave.

Repeat a short matched segment at 0.5 ms on a chosen candidate, using identical physical windows and compare gauge amplitude, phase, reflection, and where available force response. Probe half-step only if its cost is justified and bounded.

If 1 ms triggers a guard, identify the local cause: advection/interface CFL, local foil cell size, pressure/VOF solver convergence, backflow near outlet or numerical startup. Do not assume refinement fixes a CFL failure; it can worsen time-step constraints.

When preparing joined foil+wave mesh, preserve supported near-foil/prism and wave surface resolutions, check transition and validity, then perform short calm-to-wave pilot at 1 ms with full guards. If 1 ms cannot pass, prefer an evidence-supported 0.5 ms rather than relaxing safety or corrupting scientific agreement.
0.1 ms is optional targeted diagnostic or independently supported fallback, not the default for all long waves.

prior_evidence.historic_W01_problem: Earlier foil-wave continuation at dt=1 ms had interface CFL around 4.58 and later numerical air jet; no-foil 1 ms run encountered outlet backflow and 50 m/s guard at t=0.704 s. Neither is evidence that simply refining a surface mesh makes 1 ms stable.

timestep_priority.research_limitations: 1 ms temporal accuracy and robust VOF/force convergence remain hypotheses to test; do not claim validated until short matched check passes.
timestep_priority.resource_safety: Bounded separate CPU trial may coexist with M12 only after measured slowdown pilot passes; target waves dt=0.001 s, calm first, then inlet wave. Do not use second GPU or touch old held C01/foil-wave.

geometry_validation.validated_scope: CGNS face connectivity, BC identifiers, numerical node positions, free-surface band, nonnegative analytic cell volume and one span layer; no STAR-CCM+ mesh importer acceptance or wave propagation tested
geometry_validation.next: No solver while M12/M11/M10 active. After resources and hold check, ensure no-foil calm checkpoint then inlet wave propagation at 0.001 s, plus bounded temporal 0.0005 s comparison; do not assume 1 ms physical accuracy or full wave GCI.
